# Eton Venture Services

> > Eton Venture Services provides GAAP/IFRS-compliant business valuation, M&A advisory, and transaction support services for middle-market companies, led by Big-4 trained experts including Chris Walton, CFA.

Eton specializes in audit-ready valuations for transactions ranging from $5M-$150M, serving startups, mid-market companies, and private equity firms with services including 409A valuations, quality of earnings reports, fairness opinions, and purchase price allocation. The firm combines technical expertise from Big Four backgrounds with practical M&A advisory and expert testimony capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Business Valuation
- Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A)
- Purchase Price Allocation (PPA)
- Quality of Earnings (QoE)
- 409A Valuations
- Fairness Opinions
- GAAP/IFRS Compliance
- Mid-Market Companies
- Goodwill Impairment
- Intangible Assets
- Transaction Advisory
- Financial Due Diligence
- Expert Testimony
- Deal Advisory
- Audit-Ready Reports

- [Business Valuation Advisory Services in the USA | Audit-Ready Valuations](https://etonvs.com/services/business-valuation-services): GAAP/IFRS-compliant business valuation services for M&A and capital raises
